device.basis: Twelve-channel ADC with the X-T20 2.11 kernel contract (0x5ac00..0x5adf8): control +0 with start bit 0, continuous-mode bit 1 and channel enables in bits 16-25, clock divider +4, and 10-bit results at +0x10 + 4*channel. Reader 0x5ad8c requires bit 0 and the channel enable; a single conversion clears bit 0 when done (stage 2 0x13d8 waits for it). The conversion clock is unmeasured; sample_ticks is a declared input.
